title: Kotlin Source Code Structure knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Kotlin Source Code Structure”?
options: It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.
It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
Apply kotlin source code structure by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail.
It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
questions.answer_key: Apply kotlin source code structure by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Apply kotlin source code structure by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. questions.prompt: Which learning/debugging practice is most reliable for “Kotlin Source Code Structure”?
options: Assume the compiler or toolchain is broken without reducing the example.
Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
Change several unrelated parts at once and keep the result that looks plausible.
Ignore warnings and suppress failures before identifying the cause.
questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
questions.explanation: A minimal reproducible example and version-aware testing separate a real behavior from a mistaken assumption. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.

questions.prompt: Which claim should a learner avoid when applying “Kotlin Source Code Structure”?
options: Kotlin Source Code Structure removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version.
Never inspect the official API reference for the selected target.
Treat draft or experimental features as universally stable.
Expose every internal implementation detail to every caller.
questions.answer_key: Kotlin Source Code Structure removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version.
questions.explanation: The misconception to avoid is: Kotlin Source Code Structure removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.
